recentItems.title: After years of red tape, 9/11 Pentagon Memorial visitor education center breaks ground
recentItems.description:
A new visitor education center broke ground on Saturday at the National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial. The memorial honors the 184 people who died in the Sept. 11, 2001, attack on the Pentagon. Nikole Killion has more details about the center, set to open in 2029.

recentItems.title: Concerns about oil prices follow Trump to Ireland
recentItems.description:
Americans are feeling the squeeze from skyrocketing fuel prices, with gas rising 16 cents from a week ago to a nationwide average of $4.31 per gallon. Concerns about oil prices followed President Trump during his trip to Ireland this weekend. Nancy Cordes has more details.

recentItems.description:
